(1) Practice (or) Habit,  Dhammānudhamma practice ( dhammānudhamma means The practice which is always following to Lokoutara (the way to escape from worldly desires and attachments) such as morals which is the dhamma of rulues of conduct, It is practice as the doctrine of Buddha.
